info.name: Global-Fi Ultra API v1
info.description:
Complete API collection for Global-Fi Ultra financial data orchestration engine.

Render Production URL: https://backend-global-fit-ulttra.onrender.com
Local Base URL: http://localhost:4000
API Prefix: /api/v1

item.name: Health
item.description: Health check and readiness probe endpoints

request.description: Basic liveness probe - returns server status and AI feature flag
Readiness probe - checks database, Redis, and AI service connectivity

item.name: Assets
item.description: Financial asset tracking and live data

request.description: Fetch live financial data for a specific asset symbol

item.name: Financial Data
item.description: Live and cached financial data orchestration

request.description: Triggers API calls to all 6 financial data providers and returns aggregated data
Returns cached data only, no API calls triggered

item.name: Admin
item.description: Administrative endpoints for cache management and audit logs

request.description: Returns connectivity status for all external API providers

item.name: AI (Requires GROQ_API_KEY)
item.description: AI-powered financial analysis features. Requires GROQ_API_KEY to be configured.

item.name: Organizations
item.description: Multi-tenant organization management, invites, member roles
